newsitem.title: BURMA: Doctors perform Burma's first kidney transplant.
newsitem.headline: Doctors perform Burma's first kidney transplant.

text.p: Burmese doctors have performed the country's first successful kidney transplant in a Rangoon hospital, local newspapers reported on Friday.
A specialist team from Yangon (Rangoon) General Hospital and North Okkalapa hospital performed the operation on a 41-year old woman who was given a kidney by her younger sister, the papers said.
Both women were in satisfactory condition following the surgery, the newspapers said.
